bots._comment: Bots (r42, #253; reactor_core bots.rs): crew that man an empty station at a lower skill, abstract (no body, no walking). count: the bots at the start (the dev BOTS setting, 0..3). skill: the gunnery skill of a bot (the jam chance's skill, 0..100, #253 asks fixed or crew average; fixed here). levels: the captain's start priority per row of CP-01 in the order gunnery, reactor, power, helm (the stations), fire, repair, breach (the work rows, r44, crew_core's bot tasks), 0 Ignore .. 4 Max (PULSAR's five nodes, pulsar-mech-bot-priorities.md section 1). r44: walk_speed (m/s) and reach_m (m) are the bots' walk to a job's place; the bots have bodies now. tick_s: the bots' action round. clear_speed: a bot's jam clearing against a player's hold. fight_engines_limit: the POWER station's engines limit in an encounter. throttle and hot_fight_throttle: the HELM's hold, and the one in a hot fight. grace_s: the seconds after a player leaves a station before a bot may take it, so a player's setting (Manual) survives their walk.
